recognize_zh: 高倍下纖維化的膠原中可見沿纖維沉積的深藍黑色與金褐色鈣鐵結晶，形成彎曲斷裂、似菌絲的條狀物，旁邊是血管與紅血球，符合脾臟 Gamna-Gandy 小體的鐵鈣質沉著。
features: Dark blue-black linear encrustations along collagen and elastic fibers (calcium with iron)
Golden-brown refractile hemosiderin deposits and fragmented, rod-like mineralized fibers
Beaded, curved segments that can mimic fungal hyphae
Adjacent vessel with red cells and congested red pulp at the edge
describe_en: High-power view of spleen shows dense hyalinized fibrous tissue in which collagen and elastic fibers are encrusted by dark blue-black mineral deposits and golden-brown hemosiderin, forming fragmented, curved, rod-like structures. An adjacent thin-walled vessel and congested red pulp are present. There is no inflammatory reaction or identifiable organism. Findings are consistent with the ferrocalcinotic fibers of a Gamna-Gandy body; iron and calcium stains (Prussian blue, von Kossa) and GMS can confirm and exclude fungal hyphae.

ddx.vs: Fungal hyphae are uniform, septate and branch at acute angles with GMS positivity, whereas these encrusted fibers are irregular, Prussian blue positive and lack true septation.

ddx.dx: Dystrophic calcification of old infarct or hematoma
ddx.vs: Dystrophic calcification forms granular or amorphous basophilic deposits without linear iron-encrusted fibers.
Foreign material is typically polarizable and associated with foreign-body giant cells, which are absent here.
